notice: Loops and posters depict Chucksi's own tools using media already in this repository. Each source below describes its capture method: original headless recordings or CUA browser screenshots for the Website Studio starters. No people were filmed and no outside footage was used. Encoded with ffmpeg: H.264, no audio, 24 fps; posters are WebP. See the listed recording and packaging scripts.

sources.video-renderer: Drawn frame by frame by the Video page's own depth renderer, camera moves and effect engine (massless.drawFrame) on the bundled sample stills in /media/art with their precomputed depth maps (record-video.cjs). Camera moves play forward then back (ping-pong); effects close with a short crossfade into their first frame.
sources.game-previews: Re-cut from the Games gallery clips in /media/games, which tools/game_previews.py recorded headlessly with each game's own bot playing. Closed with a short crossfade into the first frame.
sources.design-artboards: Artboards rendered by the design workflow itself (/workflows?make=<id>&example=<id>) from its bundled sample frames, no AI calls, captured from the page's canvases (record-design.cjs) and assembled into a sliding carousel (slides.py).
sources.film-poem-player: Frames drawn by the Film poem workflow's own player, stepped with its scrubber (record-design.cjs).
sources.website-builder: The Website builder's own template preview at tablet width (768 px), scrolled frame by frame and captured (record-steps.cjs).
sources.edit-workroom: The Image workroom on its bundled sample photo (/media/website/ceramics.jpg). Compose: the page's own frame, backdrop, scale and headline controls stepped per frame. Remove background, upscale and erase: the tool's real on-device model output, shown with the page's own before/after slider (record-steps.cjs).
sources.depth-viewer: The 3D page's depth splat of the bundled samurai sample, orbited by dragging the viewer frame by frame (record-steps.cjs, jobs/animated.js).
sources.scene-studio: The Scene studio's default scene, orbited by dragging the viewer frame by frame (record-steps.cjs, jobs/animated.js).
sources.launch-film: The Launch film page's built-in example film, drawn by its own renderer (massless.seek) frame by frame.
sources.music-visualizer: The Music page's visualizer driving the bundled sample still /media/art/lighthouse.jpg with the bundled synthesized instrumental, stepped with its scrubber.
sources.audio-page: The Audio page's own animated voice and sound-bed preview cards over the bundled sample stills, with performance.now() stepped 1/24 s per frame (jobs/animated.js).
sources.clip-workroom: The Clip workroom burning three typed captions into its bundled LiDAR sample clip, seeking the clip frame by frame (jobs/tools.js).
sources.office: Chucksi Office on its bundled sample document and contract templates, driven with scripted clicks and typing, captured frame by frame.
sources.optical-effects-pack: 15 original browser effects rendered by EffectEngine and the existing recordSegments exporter through tests/optical-effects.html. Bundled sample stills and depth maps only; no external footage, generation API or provider model. Each loop returns to its original frame. Packaged with tools/package_effect_previews.py.
sources.website-studio-screenshots: Actual complete template pages captured in Chrome through CUA with reduced motion, then cropped into a six-second forward/back scroll using ffmpeg. Original generated photography and original template code. No external footage.
